propositions: The current clarity measure conflates volume (length, bullet count, heading presence) with structural correctness, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections (Approach, grounded Scope, per-criterion verification).
Deterministic clarity checks are duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py without a single source of truth, creating maintenance risk and potential drift.

Plan-writing guidance requires named rejected alternatives for Approach, but authoritative G6 criterion explicitly forbids requiring that, and docs/container collapse moved Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria but author guide has not been updated.
Current clarity scoring adds points to a seven-point scale, so filler can compensate for structurally missing sections; a better approach would derive compatibility from satisfied-per-check counts.
AC verification coverage (proved_items / total_items) lacks deterministic detection; existing checkboxes must be parsed to require explicit operator attestation or proving/check clauses.
